---
title: "Naive Bayes Classificator with FAMD"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
library("FactoMineR")
library("factoextra")
library("caret")
library("naivebayes")
library("ggplot2")
library(e1071)
library(klaR)
```


## Preparacio de les dades per fer el modelatge:
```{r}

#  Crear un nuevo dataframe con solo las columnas relevantes
test_selec <- test[, c("Geography", "Balance", "Age", "IsActiveMember", "NumOfProducts", "NetPromoterScore")]
train_selec <- train[, c("Geography", "Balance", "Age", "IsActiveMember", "NumOfProducts", "NetPromoterScore","Exited")]

train_selec$Exited <- factor(train_selec$Exited,
                                levels = c("1","0"),
                                labels = c("Yes","No"))
```

## Partim les dades del model train, i el 70% l'utilitzem per entenar-lo i el 30% per evaluar-lo
```{r}
set.seed(1994)
parametre <- createDataPartition(train_selec$Exited, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)
train_selec2 <- train_selec[parametre, ] 
test_selec2  <- train_selec[-parametre, ]


```

## FAMD
```{r}

# Separem predictors (X) i resposta (y)
X_train_famd <- train_selec2[, !(names(train_selec2) %in% "Exited")]
y_train_famd <- train_selec2$Exited

X_test_famd  <- test_selec2[, !(names(test_selec2) %in% "Exited")]
y_test_famd  <- test_selec2$Exited

# Apliquem FAMD directament 
train_famd <- FAMD(X_train_famd, graph = FALSE)
test_famd  <- FAMD(X_test_famd,  graph = FALSE)

# Scree plot per veure la variància explicada
fviz_screeplot(train_famd, addlabels = TRUE) +
  ggtitle("Percentatge de variància explicada (FAMD - train)")

# Convertim coordenades en data frames i afegim la resposta
train_famd_coord <- as.data.frame(train_famd$ind$coord)
test_famd_coord  <- as.data.frame(test_famd$ind$coord)

train_famd_coord$Exited <- y_train_famd
test_famd_coord$Exited  <- y_test_famd

# Harmonitzem els noms de les dimensions entre train i test
n_dims <- min(ncol(train_famd_coord) - 1, ncol(test_famd_coord) - 1)
dim_names <- paste0("Dim.", 1:n_dims)

names(train_famd_coord)[1:n_dims] <- dim_names
names(test_famd_coord)[1:n_dims]  <- dim_names

```

## Modelelatge Naive Bayes

```{r, warning=FALSE}
# Definim matrius de característiques i vectors de resposta
X_nb_train <- train_famd_coord[, dim_names]
y_nb_train <- train_famd_coord$Exited

X_nb_test  <- test_famd_coord[, dim_names]
y_nb_test  <- test_famd_coord$Exited

# Grid senzill de paràmetres per al model Naive Bayes
nb_grid <- expand.grid(
  usekernel = c(TRUE, FALSE),
  laplace   = c(0, 0.5, 1),
  adjust    = c(0.5, 1, 1.5)
)

accuracy_vals <- numeric(nrow(nb_grid))

# Bucle de validació interna sobre el train (estil "profe", però adaptat a les teves dades)
for (i in 1:nrow(nb_grid)) {
  modelo_nb <- naive_bayes(
    x         = X_nb_train,
    y         = y_nb_train,
    usekernel = nb_grid$usekernel[i],
    laplace   = nb_grid$laplace[i],
    adjust    = nb_grid$adjust[i]
  )
  
  pred_i <- predict(modelo_nb, X_nb_train)
  tab_i  <- table(Real = y_nb_train, Pred = pred_i)
  accuracy_vals[i] <- sum(diag(tab_i)) / sum(tab_i)
}

nb_grid$Accuracy <- accuracy_vals

# Combincació amb millor accuracy
nb_grid_best <- nb_grid[which.max(nb_grid$Accuracy), ]
nb_grid_best
# Model definitiu amb la millor combinació trobada
modelo_nb_final <- naive_bayes(
  x         = X_nb_train,
  y         = y_nb_train,
  usekernel = nb_grid_best$usekernel,
  laplace   = nb_grid_best$laplace,
  adjust    = nb_grid_best$adjust
)

# Prediccions sobre train i test interns
train_pred <- predict(modelo_nb_final, X_nb_train)
test_pred  <- predict(modelo_nb_final, X_nb_test)

# Matrius de confusió
conf_train <- confusionMatrix(train_pred, y_nb_train)
conf_test  <- confusionMatrix(test_pred, y_nb_test)
conf_train
conf_test

```

## KPI's
```{r}
# Funció per calcular F1 a partir de la confusionMatrix
f1_fun <- function(cm){
  prec <- cm$byClass["Pos Pred Value"]
  rec  <- cm$byClass["Sensitivity"]
  2 * (prec * rec) / (prec + rec)
}

f1_train <- as.numeric(f1_fun(conf_train))
f1_test  <- as.numeric(f1_fun(conf_test))

# Taula resum de mètriques
kpi_nb <- data.frame(
  Dataset            = c("Train", "Test"),
  Error_rate         = c(1 - conf_train$overall["Accuracy"],
                         1 - conf_test$overall["Accuracy"]),
  Accuracy           = c(conf_train$overall["Accuracy"],
                         conf_test$overall["Accuracy"]),
  Precision          = c(conf_train$byClass["Pos Pred Value"],
                         conf_test$byClass["Pos Pred Value"]),
  Recall_Sensitivity = c(conf_train$byClass["Sensitivity"],
                         conf_test$byClass["Sensitivity"]),
  Specificity        = c(conf_train$byClass["Specificity"],
                         conf_test$byClass["Specificity"]),
  F1_Score           = c(f1_train, f1_test)
)

kpi_nb

```
